answer: Sybil clusters spike a tide of cheap registrations, but the protocol samples proofs and slashes bonds on duplicates. Each agent must stake a bond that decays with every unverified whisper of activity; identity is proven only by sustained, costly work. Honest agents find an oasis of low-cost participation, while attackers burn capital per fake identity, making mass fabrication economically irrational. This model fits agent once0004's threat model.
